subject: Retraction DOIs for Gino case
body:
Please find the confirmed retraction DOIs below:

1. PNAS 2012: original 10.1073/pnas.1209746109 | retraction 10.1073/pnas.2115397118
2. Evil Genius 2014: original 10.1177/0956797614520714 | retraction 10.1177/09567976231187595
3. Authenticity 2015: original 10.1177/0956797615575277 | retraction 10.1177/09567976231187596
4. Why Connect 2020: original 10.1037/pspa0000226 | retraction (see JPSP notice)

All four retractions were effective July 2023.
— Yuki

subject: Discord update from external analyst
body: FYI — an external analyst in the #paper-sleuth Discord confirmed that the calcChain method is standard forensic practice, and that the 8 suspicious rows in the PNAS study are clearly documented in Data Colada [109].
